title: O'Shaughnessy's Pub
venue_description:
O'Shaughnessy's Pub - Historic Old Town Dive Bar

O'Shaughnessy's Pub is an iconic dive bar located at 1324 King Street in the heart of Old Town Alexandria Virginia. Formerly known as the Laughing Lizard Lounge this venue has become a cultural institution and a last bastion of authentic local character in an increasingly gentrified neighborhood. The pub maintains a genuine unpretentious atmosphere that appeals to locals seeking authenticity.

Establishment & Legacy

O'Shaughnessy's has been serving the Old Town community for decades as a gathering place for locals. The venue hosts open mic nights regular events and live music performances throughout the week. The combination of cheap drinks quality food and excellent music has created a loyal customer base spanning different generations.

Open Mic & Entertainment

Every Monday at 8pm Damian Anderson hosts open mic night where all musicians are welcome. The relaxed atmosphere encourages both seasoned performers and newcomers to take the stage. Tuesday through Saturday the venue features comedy shows and live band performances creating a diverse entertainment schedule.

Amenities & Atmosphere

Multiple well-maintained pool tables on the upper level provide recreation beyond music. An attached NYC-style deli serves hearty sandwiches and snacks. The bar features quality drinks at reasonable prices. A jukebox provides music between live performances. The overall aesthetic is classic dive bar - casual worn-in comfortable and unpretentious.

Location in Old Town

The pub is located on King Street in the historic commercial heart of Old Town Alexandria surrounded by colonial architecture shops galleries and restaurants. The neighborhood has undergone significant gentrification and upscaling making O'Shaughnessy's one of the few remaining authentic local establishments. This context makes the venue even more valued by the community.

Community Role

O'Shaughnessy's functions as more than a bar - it is a true community gathering place where locals know the bartenders bartenders know the customers and strangers quickly become part of the extended family. The venue's commitment to hosting open mic and live music supports local musicians and creative expression in an otherwise upscale commercial area.
